scope: Exactly4 new fresh-process OFF/OFF pairs of qualified fixed consumer+model task bundle. Sampler/ETW OFF throughout, common recorder/counter/retention ON. No GUI, SDK, live camera/USB, human, Run or optimization AB.
checks: Exact full-chain original report/state/raw archive; complete input/source/native hashes.
Model inputs/logical timestamps/call count/result contents exact across both runs; mismatch retained.
Logical sensor clock applies only to consumer thread; model and other native callbacks keep real clock.
Consumer and model span overlap must be observed, with separate TIDs; overlap alone is not a GIL ownership claim.
All220 model outputs retained until post-join hashing; this is synthetic controlled heap policy, not live latest-only behavior.
Close completion required but excluded from model-work span. No resampling, no speedup or field qualification claim.
Model work_done handshake blocks adapter.close until after process_after; counter brackets cover both complete task spans.
Same process identity, monotonic process times/cycles and <=1ms counter read brackets. Named-thread sum cross-check retains prior50ms tolerance, not an equivalence margin.
Both complete task identities and model result content must agree. Keep any fixed-consumer ROI model-overlap differences.
One pair validates boundaries only; no between-pair variance/3% equivalence/1% precision or root attribution. No retries replacing a failed case.
Every8 full input/model/report identities and complete process-accounting boundaries must pass; otherwise statistics withheld.
Original boundary-qualification pair is excluded. No matching subset, no reordering after results, no extra case on a failure.
Compute all4 raw pair differences including >15%; never interpret OFF/OFF variation as observer bias or claim controlled/dynamic field qualification.

statistics.independent_unit: Whole fresh-process pair, not individual threads/blocks/model calls.
statistics.wall_endpoint: Midpoint of saved whole-bundle OS-read brackets; every pair bracket ratio retained separately.
statistics.method: Bonferroni simultaneous Student-t intervals of pair log ratios; descriptive four-pair pilot with parametric independence/stationarity assumptions.
statistics.future_planning: Max endpoint log-ratio SD; once-only8..24 prospective pair count planning for log(1.01) half-width. Planning only, no ON run launched.
